description:

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Front-End Web Developer who is motivated to combine the art of design with the art of programming. Responsibilities will include translation of the UI/UX design wireframes, visual design to actual code that will produce visual elements of the product’s web portal. You will work with the UI/UX designer and product owner to bridge the gap between graphical design and technical implementation, taking an active role on both sides and defining how the Web Portal looks as well as how it works.

**Responsibilities**

* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX visual designs
* Develop cutting edge UI for product web portal
* Do quick prototypes with different libraries
* Optimize web portal for maximum speed and scalability
* Build reusable code and libraries for future use
* Guide and Review work of the Front-End developers
* Collaborate with UI/UX designer and Product owner
* Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders
* Taking self-ownership in challenging UI development work

**Must have Skills**

* Must have 4-8 yrs of experience in front end web development
* Proficient in web markup, including HTML5, CSS3, SASS and DOM
* Proficient in client-side scripting and JavaScript frameworks, including jQuery
* Proficient in React or React-variant frameworks
* Knowledge of D3 and SVG
* Experience in CSS pre-processing platforms, such as LESS and SASS
* Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them.
* Good understanding of asynchronous request handling, Single Page Application, partial page updates
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git

**Nice to have Skills**

* Knowledge of graph rendering libraries like GoJS, JointJS etc
* Knowledge of Product Development Lifecycle, Agile Scrum Development Methodology
* Knowledge of Azure Board, Sprint Planning and Execution

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. title: Lead Spartacus UI Developer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

We are seeking a highly skilled Spartacus Technical Lead to design, develop, develop, own integration architecture and DevOps pipeline for B2B SAP Spartacus (SAP Composable Storefront) implementations on SAP Commerce Cloud. This is a hands-on architecture role with the end-to-end responsibility for technical solutions, ensuring scalability, and performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with UI designer, and backend SAP Commerce Cloud developers to deliver Healthineers standards-compliant UI/UX frond end as part of our move to headless architecture.
* Develop and customize storefronts using **SAP Spartacus.**
* Integrate Spartacus with **SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris OCC APIs)**
* Customize CMS components, pages, and content slots
* Implement responsive UI/UX following best practices
* Extend and customize Spartacus components and services
* Handle authentication, cart, checkout, and product flows
* Collaborate with backend, product owners, QA, and DevOps teams.
* Support upgrades and migrations (Spartacus)

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience: 8+ years total, 3–5+ years in Spartacus / Composable Storefront / Angular**

* Deep expertise in Spartacus (SAP Composable Storefront) architecture.
* Strong technical working background of Angular.
* Hands on working experience with SAP CC **Storefront** to **Spartacus** migration.
* Experience customizing Spartacus libraries, extensions and CMS-driven storefront features.
* Knowledge of SAP Cloud Commerce (Hybris) architecture & extension framework.
* State Management – Expertise in NgRx, RxJS and performance tuning.
* Strong background in customizing Spartacus components & optimizing lazy loading.
* Excellent working knowledge and experience in application development using Angular, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery 3.0, JavaScript, Bootstrap, RESTful Web.
* Strong infrastructure knowledge hosting models for Spartacus, CDN integrations, load balancing, autoscaling, WAF, CDN caching.
* Architect CI/CD pipelines for Spartacus builds using Azure DevOps.
* API security, OAuth, Session & token management, CORS, CSP, XSS and CSRF prevention.
* SEO and performance optimization and SAP Commerce Cloud knowledge would be a plus.

title: Software Engineering Lead - Java or Python, React JS
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

As a Software Engineering Lead within Optum Technology, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of innovative full-stack software solutions. In this role, you will leverage backend technologies such as Java or Python alongside frontend frameworks like React to build modern, scalable APIs and user interfaces. You will work in an agile, quality-driven environment incorporating automated testing, DevOps practices, continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and containerized platform architectures.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of full-stack software applications utilizing React for frontend development and Java or Python for backend APIs
* Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered solutions and automated capabilities to address complex business challenges with an emphasis on responsible technology practices
* Leverage enterprise-approved automation and tools to streamline development workflows, optimize code quality, and drive continuous technical improvement
* Evaluate emerging trends and strategic innovations to inform architectural solution design and platform enhancement
* Manage and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and cloud-native application infrastructure
* Implement robust automated testing frameworks and practices (e.g., TDD, JUnit, Jest) to enforce rigorous software quality standards
* Collaborate with cross-functional technical teams, architects, and product owners to deliver scalable, secure, and resilient applications
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or 4+ years of equivalent software engineering experience
* 6+ years of experience working as a backend software developer with Java or Python
* 2+ years of experience working as a software developer with JavaScript or TypeScript
* 2+ years of experience building frontend application features using React
* 2+ years of experience designing and styling web interfaces using CSS

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Healthcare industry experience
* Experience developing REST-based APIs and microservices architectures
* Experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, and Hibernate
* Experience with Test Driven Development (TDD) using testing frameworks such as JUnit, Spock, Vitest, or Jest
* Experience designing and managing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins)
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, logging, and observability tools (e.g., Splunk, Grafana) to ensure system reliability and performance
* Experience working with relational databases such as MySQL
* Hands-on experience with container platforms and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Kubernetes Service [AKS], OpenShift)

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Delightree - Senior Design Engineer
description:
### **About the role**


This role splits roughly in half.


The first half is designing for franchise operations \- multi location brands, franchisee owners, and frontline staff each needing something different from the same product.


The second half is owning the layer between design and code. You'll own the design system \- the components, patterns, and code. You'll write frontend code yourself, and you'll define how design work becomes a shipped interface for everyone else on the team.


That second half is why this role exists. Our approach to product development is shifting. Instead of traditional mockup handoffs, product managers and designers directly build working prototypes directly in code, using AI workflows alongside our component library. Engineering builds on those prototypes rather than starting over. You own this system and ensure it's up to scale and quality.

### **What you'll do**

* Design and build UI in the same motion \- prototyping novel AI\-native interactions directly in code rather than in Figma\-then\-handoff, especially where no pattern library exists yet.
* Sit inside a pod (PM \+ eng lead \+ you) and take features from concept to shipped, rather than handing off a spec and waiting.
* Own the interaction and motion details \- loading/streaming states, transitions, micro\-interactions \- the polish that's nearly impossible to fully spec in a doc.
* Build and maintain shared UI components so the rest of the org can move fast without reinventing patterns feature by feature.
* Work directly in the production codebase.

### **What we're looking for**

* 4\+ years in product design, with depth in dense interfaces \- tables, forms, permissions, multi role flows.
* Real product/visual design judgment *and* the ability to ship real frontend code \- not a designer who dabbles in code or an engineer who cares about UI, but someone for whom design and implementation are the same skill.
* Hands\-on frontend engineering. A portfolio \+ GitHub showing shipped, interactive, polished products \- not just mockups or case studies.
* Design systems built and maintained at scale, in code. You should be able to direct AI tools to build and maintain prototypes that adhere to accessibility, component system, and other guardrails.
* Experience or strong interest in AI\-native interfaces: streaming output, agentic/human\-in\-the\-loop UX, confidence and uncertainty in UI.
* Bonus: has worked somewhere small enough that design and engineering weren't separate functions. AI used structurally in how features got shipped, from ideation through implementation and review \- not just for copy or asset generation.
